description.value: Now operating as Pomme Natural Market Duncan after joining the Pomme chain, this natural and organic grocery store sits on the Trans-Canada Highway in Duncan, making it a convenient stop for cyclists travelling the Cowichan Valley corridor. The store emphasizes local and organic products, weekly produce specials, and a community-oriented ethos with long-standing staff continuity through the rebrand.
